title: Rav Huna bar Berekhyah

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Berakhot 63a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.63a.20), where he said in the name of Rabbi Elazar HaKappar: “Whoever joins the name of Heaven to his suffering, his livelihood is doubled.”[^1]

notes.text: Rav Huna bar Berekhyah transmits the saying in Rabbi Elazar HaKappar’s name. The linked Gemara adduces a verse from Job.
